links.outcome: Gap between exam-question accuracy and explanation quality/image interpretation of GPT-4V
links.effect: High accuracy (73.1-88.9%) but among incorrect answers 18.2% (10/55) inaccurate text, 45.5% (25/55) inference errors, 76.3% (42/55) image misunderstandings.
links.quote: However, incorrect answers often had poor explanation quality: 18.2% (10/55) contained inaccurate text, 45.5% (25/55) had inference errors, and 76.3% (42/55) demonstrated image misunderstandings.

links.outcome: Effect of human expert assistance on GPT-4V errors
links.effect: With human expert assistance, GPT-4V reduced errors by an average of 40% (22/55); image interpretation flaws not efficiently resolved through expert interaction.
links.quote: With human expert assistance, GPT-4V reduced errors by an average of 40% (22/55).

unlisted_practices: Evaluating explanation quality of multimodal model against expert-written explanations
Prompt hints improving multimodal model accuracy

screen.reason: The study benchmarks GPT-4V, GPT-4, and GPT-3.5 Turbo on multimodal medical exam questions (USMLE, AMBOSS) and analyzes error patterns and explanation quality without testing an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
